_about: 교재 실사형 설명 사진 목록(2026-10-19, 원장: 실사 수준으로). scripts/book-photos.py 가 장면마다 후보 3장을 만든다. 사람 얼굴은 특정인이 아니게, 글자·상표는 넣지 않는다. 교재에는 'AI 실사형 설명 이미지 · 실제 사진 아님'으로 밝힌다.
style: professional editorial photograph for a Korean elementary school science textbook, photorealistic, natural colors, sharp focus, realistic textures, soft natural daylight, shot on a full-frame camera with a 35mm lens, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no captions

shots.use: 과학 탐구 프로그램(v1) 첫 화면 배경 — 기록 보관소 복도
shots.prompt: A long dark underground archive corridor in cinematic low light, seen from slightly left of center with a strong one-point perspective toward a vanishing point on the right third of the frame. On the left, a tall raw board-formed concrete wall, softly lit and empty. On the right, floor-to-ceiling glass-fronted steel archive cabinets filled with rows of file boxes and folders, receding into the distance. Thin warm white LED light strips run along the ceiling edges and converge at the vanishing point. A polished dark stone floor with long glossy reflections of the light strips. Deep shadows, muted warm grey and bronze tones, moody museum atmosphere, empty, no people. The center of the frame is dark open space. Cinematic architectural photograph, photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera with a 24mm lens, rich shadow detail, no text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermark.

A classroom science model on a light wooden table, three-quarter view from slightly above. A clear rectangular plastic storage tub about 40 centimeters long. Inside, the left third is shallow light-blue water like a small sea. The rest is a coastal landscape sculpted from green and tan modeling clay: a small steep hill right at the water's edge, a low sandy beach near the water, a little clay riverbank, a flat low plain further inland, and a higher hill at the back. Five tiny white paper houses with red roofs stand on the clay, one on top of the hill beside the water, one on the low beach, one by the riverbank, one on the inland plain, one on the far back hill. A transparent plastic ruler stands upright inside the tub at the water's edge. A plastic measuring cup filled with water sits next to the tub. Bright classroom with blurred windows in the background.

Close-up of a child's hand slowly pouring water from a plastic measuring cup into one corner of a clear plastic tub that contains a handmade clay coastal-village model with small paper houses with red roofs. The water in the tub is light blue and calm, a transparent ruler stands upright at the water's edge. Light wooden classroom table, soft window light, shallow depth of field. Only the hand and forearm are visible.

A hot summer afternoon on a city sidewalk in South Korea, strong sunlight and visible heat shimmer above the asphalt, pedestrians seen from behind walking under sun parasols and wiping sweat, a sun-shade canopy at a crosswalk, apartment buildings in the background, hazy bright sky. Red apples ripening on trees in an apple orchard on a hillside in early autumn, rows of apple trees, a farmer's woven basket of apples on the grass in the foreground, mountains in the background, clear daylight.

A coal-fired power plant with tall chimneys releasing grey smoke into the sky, conveyor belts and piles of black coal in the foreground, industrial buildings, late afternoon light. Documentary photograph.
